# PALAVER_DOTENV_DIRECT_LOAD_START
def _palaver_load_env_file():
    import os
    from pathlib import Path

    root = Path.home() / "savant-runtime"
    env = root / ".env"

    if not env.exists():
        return

    for raw in env.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
        line = raw.strip()

        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
            continue

        key, value = line.split("=", 1)
        key = key.strip()
        value = value.strip().strip('"').strip("'")

        if key and key not in os.environ:
            os.environ[key] = value

_palaver_load_env_file()
# PALAVER_DOTENV_DIRECT_LOAD_END


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
RUNTIME = ROOT / "runtime"
PORT = int(os.getenv("PALAVER_WEB_PORT", "8787"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(RUNTIME))


def load_env():
    env = ROOT / ".env"
    if not env.exists():
        return
    for line in env.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
            continue
        k, v = line.split("=", 1)
        os.environ.setdefault(k.strip(), v.strip().strip('"').strip("'"))


load_env()

const chat=document.getElementById("chat"),input=document.getElementById("input"),trace=document.getElementById("trace"),statusEl=document.getElementById("status"),patchOut=document.getElementById("patchOut"),drawer=document.getElementById("drawer"),paletteInput=document.getElementById("paletteInput");
let currentFile="";
function esc(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#039;"}[m]))}
function add(role,text){const el=document.createElement("div");el.className="msg "+role;el.innerHTML=`<div class="msgHeader">${role==="user"?"YOU":"PALAVER"}</div><div class="msgBody">${esc(text)}</div>`;chat.appendChild(el);el.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"end"})}
function fill(x){input.value=x;input.focus()}
function focusChat(){input.focus()}
function togglePalette(open){drawer.classList.toggle("open",open);if(open)setTimeout(()=>paletteInput.focus(),60)}
function runPalette(){const v=paletteInput.value.trim();if(!v)return;paletteInput.value="";togglePalette(false);send(v)}
function paletteRun(v){paletteInput.value="";togglePalette(false);send(v)}
async function submitMsg(){const m=input.value.trim();if(!m)return;input.value="";await send(m)}
async function send(message){add("user",message);statusEl.innerHTML='<span class="dot"></span><span>thinking</span>';trace.textContent="running";try{const res=await fetch("/api/chat",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({message})});const data=await res.json();add("assistant",data.answer||"(empty response)");trace.textContent=data.trace||""}catch(e){add("assistant","Browser/API error: "+e);trace.textContent=String(e)}statusEl.innerHTML='<span class="dot"></span><span>online</span>'}
async function patchWrite(){const path=document.getElementById("patchPath").value.trim(),content=document.getElementById("patchContent").value;const res=await fetch("/api/patch/write",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({path,content,intent:"browser write proposal"})});const data=await res.json();patchOut.textContent=data.output||JSON.stringify(data,null,2)}
async function patchAppend(){const path=document.getElementById("patchPath").value.trim(),content=document.getElementById("patchContent").value;const res=await fetch("/api/patch/append",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({path,content,intent:"browser append proposal"})});const data=await res.json();patchOut.textContent=data.output||JSON.stringify(data,null,2)}
async function loadTree(path=""){
 try{
  const res=await fetch("/api/tree?path="+encodeURIComponent(path));
  const data=await res.json();
  if(!data.ok){trace.textContent=data.error||"tree failed";return}
  if(!path){
    document.getElementById("fileTree").innerHTML=renderTree(data.tree);
  }else{
    const holder=document.querySelector(`[data-children="${cssEscape(path)}"]`);
    if(holder) holder.innerHTML=(data.tree.children||[]).map(renderTree).join("");
  }
 }catch(e){trace.textContent=String(e)}
}

function cssEscape(s){
 return String(s).replace(/["\\]/g,"\\$&");
}

function renderTree(node){
 const icon=node.type==="directory"?"▸":"•";
 const cls=node.type==="directory"?"treeDir":"treeFile";
 const path=node.path||"";
 const safe=path.replaceAll("'","\\'");
 let click=node.type==="file"
   ? `openFile('${safe}')`
   : `toggleDir('${safe}')`;
 let html=`<div class="treeItem ${cls}" onclick="${click}">${icon} ${esc(node.name)}</div>`;
 if(node.type==="directory"){
   html+=`<div data-children="${esc(path)}" style="padding-left:12px">`;
   if(node.children){
     for(const child of node.children)html+=renderTree(child);
   }
   html+=`</div>`;
 }
 return html;
}

 const holder=document.querySelector(`[data-children="${cssEscape(path)}"]`);
 if(!holder)return;
 if(holder.dataset.loaded==="1"){
   holder.style.display=holder.style.display==="none"?"block":"none";
   return;
 }
 holder.dataset.loaded="1";
 await loadTree(path);
}

def now():
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def send_json(h, payload, code=200):
    data = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode()
    h.send_response(code)
    h.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
    h.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
    h.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
    h.end_headers()
    h.wfile.write(data)


def send_html(h, html, code=200):
    data = html.encode()
    h.send_response(code)
    h.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
    h.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
    h.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
    h.end_headers()
    h.wfile.write(data)


def body_json(h):
    n = int(h.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
    raw = h.rfile.read(n).decode() if n else "{}"
    try:
        return json.loads(raw)
    except Exception:
        return {}


def run_cmd(args, input_text=None):
    p = subprocess.run(args, cwd=str(ROOT), input=input_text, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
    return {"ok": p.returncode == 0, "out": (p.stdout or "") + (("\n[stderr]\n" + p.stderr) if p.stderr else ""), "code": p.returncode}


def health():
    return {
        "root": str(ROOT),
        "api_key_present": bool(os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")),
        "model": os.getenv("SAVANT_MODEL", "gpt-5"),
        "core_available": bool(diagnostics),
        "file_tool": (ROOT / "file").exists(),
        "search_tool": (ROOT / "search").exists(),
        "retrieve_tool": (ROOT / "retrieve").exists(),
        "patch_tool": (ROOT / "patch").exists(),
        "graph_info": (ROOT / "graph_info").exists(),
    }


def safe_rel_path(path):
    path = (path or "").strip().lstrip("/")
    target = (ROOT / path).resolve()
    root = ROOT.resolve()
    if not (str(target).startswith(str(root) + "/") or target == root):
        raise RuntimeError("blocked outside root")
    rel = target.relative_to(root)
    if any(x in {".git", ".venv", "__pycache__", "node_modules"} for x in rel.parts):
        raise RuntimeError("blocked protected path")
    return target, str(rel)


def build_file_tree(base=None, max_depth=2, depth=0):
    target = ROOT if base is None else base

    node = {
        "name": "savant-runtime" if target == ROOT else target.name,
        "path": "" if target == ROOT else str(target.relative_to(ROOT)),
        "type": "directory" if target.is_dir() else "file",
    }

    if not target.is_dir():
        return node

    children = []

    try:
        items = sorted(
            target.iterdir(),
            key=lambda x: (
                x.is_file(),
                x.name.lower(),
            )
        )

        count = 0

        for child in items:
            if child.name in {
                ".git",
                ".venv",
                "__pycache__",
                "node_modules",
                ".pytest_cache",
                ".mypy_cache",
            }:
                continue

            if count >= 300:
                children.append({
                    "name": "[truncated]",
                    "path": node["path"],
                    "type": "file",
                })
                break

            if child.is_dir():
                children.append({
                    "name": child.name,
                    "path": str(child.relative_to(ROOT)),
                    "type": "directory",
                    "children": [],
                    "lazy": True,
                })
            else:
                try:
                    size = child.stat().st_size
                except Exception:
                    size = 0

                if size <= 750000:
                    children.append({
                        "name": child.name,
                        "path": str(child.relative_to(ROOT)),
                        "type": "file",
                        "size": size,
                    })

            count += 1

    except Exception:
        pass

    node["children"] = children
    return node


def list_directory_payload(path=""):
    target, rel = safe_rel_path(path)

    if not target.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("missing path")

    if not target.is_dir():
        raise RuntimeError("not a directory")

    return build_file_tree(target, max_depth=1, depth=0)


def read_file_payload(path):
    target, rel = safe_rel_path(path)
    if not target.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("missing file")
    if not target.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError("not a file")
    text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
    return {"path": rel, "size": len(text), "content": text[:160000]}

def save_file_payload(path, content):
    target, rel = safe_rel_path(path)

    if any(x in {".git", ".venv", "__pycache__", "node_modules"} for x in target.relative_to(ROOT).parts):
        raise RuntimeError("blocked protected path")

    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")

    return {
        "path": rel,
        "bytes": len(content.encode("utf-8")),
    }


def diff_payload(path, proposed):
    import difflib

    target, rel = safe_rel_path(path)

    before = ""
    if target.exists() and target.is_file():
        before = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")

    diff = "".join(
        difflib.unified_diff(
            before.splitlines(True),
            proposed.splitlines(True),
            fromfile=f"before/{rel}",
            tofile=f"after/{rel}",
        )
    )

    return {
        "path": rel,
        "diff": diff,
    }

def direct_command(message):
    low = message.lower().strip()

    if low in {"health", "status"}:
        return {"answer": json.dumps(health(), indent=2), "trace": "health"}

    if low == "diag":
        if diagnostics:
            return {"answer": json.dumps(diagnostics(), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), "trace": "diagnostics"}
        return {"answer": "diagnostics unavailable", "trace": "diagnostics unavailable"}

    if low == "files":
        r = run_cmd(["./file", "list", ".", "--limit", "1000"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "file list"}

    if low.startswith("file read "):
        target = message[len("file read "):].strip()
        r = run_cmd(["./file", "read", target, "--start", "1", "--end", "900"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "file read"}

    if low.startswith("search "):
        q = message[len("search "):].strip()
        r = run_cmd(["./search", "term", q, "--limit", "80"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "search"}

    if low.startswith("retrieve "):
        q = message[len("retrieve "):].strip()
        r = run_cmd(["./retrieve", "term", q, "--limit", "30"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "retrieve"}

    if low == "graph":
        r = run_cmd(["./graph_info"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "graph"}

    if low == "patches":
        r = run_cmd(["./patch", "list"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "patch list"}

    if low == "repository report":
        r = run_cmd(["./repository", "report"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "repository report"}

    if low == "repository scan":
        r = run_cmd(["./repository", "scan"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "repository scan"}

    if low.startswith("patch show "):
        pid = message[len("patch show "):].strip()
        r = run_cmd(["./patch", "show", pid])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "patch show"}

    if low.startswith("patch apply "):
        pid = message[len("patch apply "):].strip()
        r = run_cmd(["./patch", "apply", pid])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "patch apply"}

    if low == "rebuild":
        if rebuild_all:
            return {"answer": json.dumps(rebuild_all(), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), "trace": "rebuild_all"}
        r = run_cmd(["./rebuild_search_index.sh"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "rebuild fallback"}

    return None


def call_openai(message, context=""):
    key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
    if not key:
        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY missing")

    user = message if not context else "Context:\n" + context + "\n\nUser:\n" + message
    payload = {"model": os.getenv("SAVANT_MODEL", "gpt-5"), "input": [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT}, {"role": "user", "content": user}]}
    req = urllib.request.Request("https://api.openai.com/v1/responses", data=json.dumps(payload).encode(), headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"}, method="POST")

    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120, context=ssl.create_default_context()) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())

    if data.get("output_text"):
        return data["output_text"]

    texts = []
    for item in data.get("output", []):
        for c in item.get("content", []):
            if c.get("text"):
                texts.append(c["text"])
    return "\n".join(texts).strip() or json.dumps(data, indent=2)


def persist(user, assistant, trace):
    d = ROOT / "vault" / "web_chats"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stamp = datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")
    (d / f"{stamp}.json").write_text(json.dumps({"timestamp": now(), "user": user, "assistant": assistant, "trace": trace}, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def chat(message):
    cmd = direct_command(message)
    if cmd:
        persist(message, cmd["answer"], cmd["trace"])
        return cmd

    trace = []
    context = ""

    if memory_block_for_prompt:
        try:
            context = memory_block_for_prompt(message, limit=8) or ""
            trace.append("memory attached" if context else "memory empty")
        except Exception as e:
            trace.append("memory error: " + str(e))

    try:
        answer = call_openai(message, context)
        trace.append("openai ok")
    except Exception as e:
        answer = "AI response failed:\n\n" + str(e) + "\n\nRun health. Commands still work."
        trace.append("openai failed")

    persist(message, answer, "\n".join(trace))
    return {"answer": answer, "trace": "\n".join(trace)}

def repository_files_payload(limit=2500):
    indexed = (
        ROOT /
        "vault" /
        "repository" /
        "files" /
        "files.json"
    )

    if indexed.exists():
        try:
            data = json.loads(
                indexed.read_text(
                    encoding="utf-8"
                )
            )

            return [
                x.get("path")
                for x in data.get("files", [])
                if x.get("path")
            ][:limit]

        except Exception:
            pass

    fallback_roots = [
        ROOT / "runtime",
        ROOT / "webui_ultra",
        ROOT / "webui-nextgen" / "src",
        ROOT / "docs",
    ]

    rows = []

    for base in fallback_roots:
        if not base.exists():
            continue

        for f in base.rglob("*"):
            if not f.is_file():
                continue

            rows.append(
                str(
                    f.relative_to(ROOT)
                )
            )

            if len(rows) >= limit:
                return rows

    return rows


def memory_files_payload(limit=500):
    roots = [
        ROOT / "vault" / "web_chats",
        ROOT / "vault" / "message_registry",
        ROOT / "vault" / "knowledge",
        ROOT / "sessions",
    ]

    rows = []

    for base in roots:
        if not base.exists():
            continue

        for f in base.glob("*.json"):
            rows.append(str(f.relative_to(ROOT)))
            if len(rows) >= limit:
                return rows

    return rows

def read_text_payload(relative, limit=200000):
    target = (ROOT / relative).resolve()
    root = ROOT.resolve()

    try:
        target.relative_to(root)
    except Exception:
        return {"ok": False, "error": "path escapes root", "path": relative}

    if not target.exists():
        return {"ok": False, "error": "missing", "path": relative}

    try:
        text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    except Exception as e:
        return {"ok": False, "error": str(e), "path": relative}

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "path": relative,
        "bytes": len(text.encode("utf-8")),
        "truncated": len(text) > limit,
        "text": text[:limit],
    }


def read_json_payload(relative, limit=200000):
    import json

    payload = read_text_payload(relative, limit=limit)

    if not payload.get("ok"):
        return payload

    try:
        payload["json"] = json.loads(payload["text"])
    except Exception as e:
        payload["json_error"] = str(e)

    return payload


def latest_matching_payload(glob_pattern, text=True):
    files = sorted(ROOT.glob(glob_pattern))

    if not files:
        return {"ok": False, "error": "no match", "glob": glob_pattern}

    rel = str(files[-1].relative_to(ROOT))

    if text:
        return read_text_payload(rel)

    return read_json_payload(rel)

    except Exception as e:

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        try:
            parsed = urlparse(self.path)
            path = parsed.path

            if path == "/api/observatory/authority":
                try:
                    import subprocess
                    subprocess.run(
                        [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "runtime" / "palaver" / "authority" / "authority_engine.py")],
                        cwd=str(ROOT),
                        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                        text=True,
                        timeout=20,
                    )
                    target = ROOT / "vault" / "authority" / "authority_index.json"
                    send_json(self, json.loads(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if target.exists() else {"top": []})
                    return
                except Exception as e:
                    send_json(self, {"error": str(e), "top": []})
                    return

            if path == "/api/observatory/lineage":
                try:
                    import subprocess
                    subprocess.run(
                        [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "runtime" / "palaver" / "lineage" / "lineage_engine.py")],
                        cwd=str(ROOT),
                        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                        text=True,
                        timeout=20,
                    )
                    target = ROOT / "vault" / "lineage" / "lineage_index.json"
                    send_json(self, json.loads(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if target.exists() else {"records": []})
                    return
                except Exception as e:
                    send_json(self, {"error": str(e), "records": []})
                    return

            if path == "/api/observatory/search":
                try:
                    import subprocess
                    query = parse_qs(parsed.query).get("q", [""])[0]
                    proc = subprocess.run(
                        [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "runtime" / "palaver" / "search" / "search_fabric.py"), query],
                        cwd=str(ROOT),
                        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                        text=True,
                        timeout=20,
                    )
                    if proc.returncode == 0 and proc.stdout.strip():
                        send_json(self, json.loads(proc.stdout))
                        return
                    send_json(self, {"query": query, "count": 0, "results": [], "stderr": proc.stderr[-2000:]})
                    return
                except Exception as e:
                    send_json(self, {"error": str(e), "results": []})
                    return


            if path == "/api/graph":
                try:
                    import subprocess
                    graph_path = ROOT / "vault" / "graphs" / "runtime_graph.json"

                    subprocess.run(
                        [
                            sys.executable,
                            str(ROOT / "runtime" / "palaver" / "graph" / "runtime_graph_engine.py")
                        ],
                        cwd=str(ROOT),
                        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                        text=True,
                        timeout=20,
                    )

                    if graph_path.exists():
                        send_json(self, json.loads(graph_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
                        return

                    send_json(self, {"nodes": [], "edges": [], "error": "runtime graph missing"})
                    return

                except Exception as e:
                    send_json(self, {"nodes": [], "edges": [], "error": str(e)})
                    return


                except Exception as e:
                    send_json(
                        self,
                        {
                            "error": str(e)
                        }
                    )
                    return

            # PALAVER_PERSONALITY_PHASE_2_ROUTES_START
            if path == "/api/personality/evolution":

            if path == "/api/memory/search":
                term = q.get("q", [""])[0].lower().strip()
                rows = []

                roots = [
                    ROOT / "vault" / "web_chats",
                    ROOT / "vault" / "knowledge",
                    ROOT / "vault" / "message_registry",
                ]

                if term:
                    for base in roots:
                        if not base.exists():
                            continue

                        for f in base.glob("*.json"):
                            try:
                                text = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
                            except Exception:
                                continue

                            if term in text.lower():
                                rows.append({
                                    "path": str(f.relative_to(ROOT)),
                                    "preview": text[:500],
                                })

                                if len(rows) >= 50:
                                    break

                        if len(rows) >= 50:
                            break

                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "results": rows})
                return

            crash = ROOT / "vault" / "diagnostics" / "crashes"
            crash.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            stamp = datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")
            tb = traceback.format_exc()
            (crash / f"get_{stamp}.txt").write_text(tb, encoding="utf-8")
            send_json(self, {"ok": False, "error": str(e), "traceback": tb}, 500)

    def do_POST(self):
        try:
            path = urlparse(self.path).path
            data = body_json(self)

            if path == "/api/chat":
                message = data.get("message", "").strip()
                if not message:
                    send_json(self, {"ok": False, "answer": "", "trace": "empty"})
                    return
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, **chat(message)})
                return

            if path == "/api/file/save":
                target = data.get("path", "").strip()
                content = data.get("content", "")
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "file": save_file_payload(target, content)})
                return

            if path == "/api/file/diff":
                target = data.get("path", "").strip()
                content = data.get("content", "")
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "diff": diff_payload(target, content)})
                return

            if path == "/api/workspace/save":
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "result": workspace_state_save(data)})
                return

            if path == "/api/patch/write":
                target = data.get("path", "").strip()
                content = data.get("content", "")
                intent = data.get("intent", "browser write proposal")
                r = run_cmd(["./patch", "write", target, "--stdin", "--intent", intent], input_text=content)
                send_json(self, {"ok": r["ok"], "output": r["out"]})
                return

            if path == "/api/patch/append":
                target = data.get("path", "").strip()
                content = data.get("content", "")
                intent = data.get("intent", "browser append proposal")
                r = run_cmd(["./patch", "append", target, "--stdin", "--intent", intent], input_text=content)
                send_json(self, {"ok": r["ok"], "output": r["out"]})
                return

            if path == "/api/patch-review/create":
                target = data.get("path", "").strip()
                content = data.get("content", "")
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "patch": patch_review_create_payload(target, content)})
                return

            if path == "/api/patch-review/apply":
                patch_id = data.get("patch_id", "").strip()
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "patch": patch_review_apply_payload(patch_id)})
                return

            if path == "/api/patch-review/reject":
                patch_id = data.get("patch_id", "").strip()
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "patch": patch_review_reject_payload(patch_id)})
                return

            send_json(self, {"ok": False, "error": "not found"}, 404)

        except Exception as e:
            crash = ROOT / "vault" / "diagnostics" / "crashes"
            crash.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            stamp = datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")
            (crash / f"server_{stamp}.txt").write_text(traceback.format_exc(), encoding="utf-8")
            send_json(self, {"ok": False, "answer": "Server route crashed.", "trace": str(e)}, 500)


def main():
    print(f"Palaver Ultra running: http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}")
    ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", PORT), Handler).serve_forever()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path("/root/savant-runtime")

PYTHON = ROOT / "bin" / "identity-quality-python"

BUILDER = ROOT / "bin" / "masterplan-build"

PROJECTOR = (
    ROOT
    / "tools"
    / "niche"
    / "masterplan"
    / "project_masterplan_markdown.py"
)

MASTERPLANCTL = ROOT / "bin" / "masterplanctl"

ROADMAP = ROOT / "docs" / "SAVANT_MASTER_TASKS.md"


def execute(command: list[str]) -> int:
    return subprocess.run(
        command,
        cwd=str(ROOT),
        check=False,
    ).returncode


def project(
    *,
    rebuild: bool,
    strict: bool,
    remaining: list[str],
) -> int:
    if rebuild:
        status = execute(
            [
                str(BUILDER),
                "strict" if strict else "build",
            ]
        )

        if status:
            return status

    if not PROJECTOR.is_file():
        print(
            f"ERROR: projector missing: {PROJECTOR}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

        return 1

    command = [
        str(PYTHON),
        str(PROJECTOR),
    ]

    if strict:
        command.append("--strict")

    command.extend(remaining)

    return execute(command)


def usage() -> int:
    print(
        """
masterplan-project build
masterplan-project strict
masterplan-project refresh
masterplan-project refresh-strict
masterplan-project verify
masterplan-project show
"""
    )

    return 0


def main() -> int:
    arguments = sys.argv[1:]

    if not arguments:
        return usage()

    command = arguments[0]
    remaining = arguments[1:]

    if command in {
        "help",
        "--help",
        "-h",
    }:
        return usage()

    if command == "build":
        return project(
            rebuild=False,
            strict=False,
            remaining=remaining,
        )

    if command == "strict":
        return project(
            rebuild=False,
            strict=True,
            remaining=remaining,
        )

    if command == "refresh":
        return project(
            rebuild=True,
            strict=False,
            remaining=remaining,
        )

    if command == "refresh-strict":
        return project(
            rebuild=True,
            strict=True,
            remaining=remaining,
        )

    if command == "verify":
        status = project(
            rebuild=True,
            strict=True,
            remaining=[],
        )

        if status:
            return status

        return execute(
            [
                str(MASTERPLANCTL),
                "verify",
            ]
        )

    if command == "show":
        if not ROADMAP.is_file():
            status = project(
                rebuild=True,
                strict=True,
                remaining=[],
            )

            if status:
                return status

        print(
            ROADMAP.read_text(
                encoding="utf-8",
            ),
            end="",
        )

        return 0

    print(
        f"ERROR: unknown command: {command}",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

    return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

class SpyralError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def canonical_json(
    value: Any,
) -> str:
    return json.dumps(
        value,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        default=str,
    )


def digest(
    value: Any,
) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(
        canonical_json(value).encode(
            "utf-8"
        )
    ).hexdigest()


def normalize_version(
    value: Any,
) -> tuple[int, ...] | None:
    if value is None:
        return None

    text = str(value).strip()

    if not text:
        return None

    match = re.fullmatch(
        r"v?(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?(?:\.(\d+))?",
        text,
    )

    if match is None:
        return None

    return tuple(
        int(part or 0)
        for part in match.groups()
    )


@dataclass(
    frozen=True,
    slots=True,
)
class Compatibility:
    state: str
    reasons: tuple[str, ...]
    source_version: str | None = None
    target_version: str | None = None

    def __post_init__(
        self,
    ) -> None:
        if (
            self.state
            not in COMPATIBILITY_STATES
        ):
            raise SpyralError(
                "invalid compatibility state: "
                + self.state
            )

    def projection(
        self,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload = {
            "state": self.state,
            "reasons": list(
                self.reasons
            ),
            "source_version":
                self.source_version,
            "target_version":
                self.target_version,
            "authoritative": False,
        }

        payload["digest"] = digest(
            payload
        )

        return payload


@dataclass(
    frozen=True,
    slots=True,
)
class Transition:
    transition_id: str
    subject_id: str
    baseline: Mapping[str, Any]
    target: Mapping[str, Any]
    dependencies: tuple[str, ...]
    compatibility: Compatibility
    migration_steps: tuple[
        Mapping[str, Any],
        ...
    ]
    recovery_steps: tuple[
        Mapping[str, Any],
        ...
    ]
    supersedes: str | None
    lineage: Any
    provenance: Any

    def projection(
        self,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload = {
            "transition_id":
                self.transition_id,
            "subject_id":
                self.subject_id,
            "baseline":
                dict(self.baseline),
            "target":
                dict(self.target),
            "dependencies":
                list(self.dependencies),
            "compatibility":
                self.compatibility
                .projection(),
            "migration_steps": [
                dict(step)
                for step
                in self.migration_steps
            ],
            "recovery_steps": [
                dict(step)
                for step
                in self.recovery_steps
            ],
            "supersedes":
                self.supersedes,
            "lineage":
                self.lineage,
            "provenance":
                self.provenance,
            "authoritative":
                False,
            "mutation_performed":
                False,
        }

        payload["digest"] = digest(
            payload
        )

        return payload


class Spyral:
    schema = (
        "savant://runtime/"
        "spyral/1.0.0"
    )

    substrate_id = (
        "living:spyral"
    )

    def __init__(
        self,
        instance_path:
            Path = DEFAULT_INSTANCE,
    ) -> None:
        if not instance_path.is_absolute():
            raise SpyralError(
                "instance path must "
                "be absolute"
            )

        self.instance_path = (
            instance_path.resolve()
        )

        self.instance = (
            self._load_json(
                self.instance_path
            )
        )

        self._validate_instance()

    @staticmethod
    def _load_json(
        path: Path,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if not path.is_file():
            raise SpyralError(
                f"missing file: {path}"
            )

        try:
            payload = json.loads(
                path.read_text(
                    encoding="utf-8"
                )
            )
        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
            raise SpyralError(
                f"invalid JSON: {path}: "
                f"{exc}"
            ) from exc

        if not isinstance(
            payload,
            dict,
        ):
            raise SpyralError(
                f"invalid object: {path}"
            )

        return payload

    def _validate_instance(
        self,
    ) -> None:
        if (
            self.instance.get(
                "substrate"
            )
            != "spyral"
        ):
            raise SpyralError(
                "invalid Spyral substrate"
            )

        if (
            self.instance.get(
                "authoritative"
            )
            is not False
        ):
            raise SpyralError(
                "Spyral must remain "
                "non-authoritative"
            )

        if (
            self.instance.get(
                "mutation_authorized"
            )
            is not False
        ):
            raise SpyralError(
                "Spyral mutation must "
                "remain disabled"
            )

        if (
            self.instance.get(
                "migration_execution_authorized"
            )
            is not False
        ):
            raise SpyralError(
                "Spyral plans migration; "
                "it does not execute mutation"
            )

        policy = self.instance.get(
            "policy",
            {},
        )

        if len(policy) != 9:
            raise SpyralError(
                "Spyral policy must "
                "contain 9 controls"
            )

        if not all(
            isinstance(value, bool)
            for value
            in policy.values()
        ):
            raise SpyralError(
                "Spyral policy controls "
                "must be boolean"
            )

        groups = self.instance.get(
            "enhancement_groups",
            {},
        )

        if len(groups) != 9:
            raise SpyralError(
                "Spyral requires "
                "9 enhancement groups"
            )

        for name, values in (
            groups.items()
        ):
            if (
                not isinstance(
                    values,
                    list,
                )
                or len(values) != 3
                or not all(
                    isinstance(
                        value,
                        str,
                    )
                    and value.strip()
                    for value in values
                )
            ):
                raise SpyralError(
                    f"{name} must contain "
                    "exactly 3 enhancements"
                )

    @property
    def enhancement_count(
        self,
    ) -> int:
        return sum(
            len(values)
            for values
            in self.instance[
                "enhancement_groups"
            ].values()
        )

    def compatibility(
        self,
        baseline:
            Mapping[str, Any],
        target:
            Mapping[str, Any],
    ) -> Compatibility:
        reasons: list[str] = []

        baseline_id = (
            baseline.get("id")
            or baseline.get(
                "identity"
            )
        )

        target_id = (
            target.get("id")
            or target.get(
                "identity"
            )
        )

        if (
            self.instance[
                "policy"
            ][
                "preserve_identity"
            ]
            and baseline_id
            and target_id
            and baseline_id
            != target_id
        ):
            return Compatibility(
                state="breaking",
                reasons=(
                    "semantic identity changes",
                ),
                source_version=str(
                    baseline.get(
                        "version"
                    )
                )
                if baseline.get(
                    "version"
                )
                is not None
                else None,
                target_version=str(
                    target.get(
                        "version"
                    )
                )
                if target.get(
                    "version"
                )
                is not None
                else None,
            )

        before = normalize_version(
            baseline.get(
                "version"
            )
        )

        after = normalize_version(
            target.get(
                "version"
            )
        )

        if (
            before is None
            or after is None
        ):
            reasons.append(
                "version compatibility "
                "cannot be fully established"
            )

            state = "unknown"

        elif after < before:
            reasons.append(
                "target version precedes "
                "baseline version"
            )

            state = (
                "conditionally-compatible"
            )

        elif (
            after[0]
            > before[0]
        ):
            reasons.append(
                "major version changes"
            )

            state = (
                "conditionally-compatible"
            )

        else:
            reasons.append(
                "identity is preserved "
                "and version transition "
                "does not cross a major boundary"
            )

            state = "compatible"

        baseline_schema = (
            baseline.get(
                "schema"
            )
        )

        target_schema = (
            target.get(
                "schema"
            )
        )

        if (
            baseline_schema
            and target_schema
            and baseline_schema
            != target_schema
        ):
            reasons.append(
                "schema identity changes"
            )

            if state == "compatible":
                state = (
                    "conditionally-compatible"
                )

        return Compatibility(
            state=state,
            reasons=tuple(
                reasons
            ),
            source_version=(
                str(
                    baseline.get(
                        "version"
                    )
                )
                if baseline.get(
                    "version"
                )
                is not None
                else None
            ),
            target_version=(
                str(
                    target.get(
                        "version"
                    )
                )
                if target.get(
                    "version"
                )
                is not None
                else None
            ),
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _normalize_steps(
        values:
            Iterable[
                Mapping[str, Any]
            ],
    ) -> tuple[
        Mapping[str, Any],
        ...,
    ]:
        result: list[
            Mapping[str, Any]
        ] = []

        for ordinal, value in (
            enumerate(
                values,
                start=1,
            )
        ):
            if not isinstance(
                value,
                Mapping,
            ):
                raise SpyralError(
                    "transition steps "
                    "must be mappings"
                )

            step = dict(
                value
            )

            step.setdefault(
                "ordinal",
                ordinal,
            )

            step.setdefault(
                "mutation_authorized",
                False,
            )

            result.append(
                step
            )

        return tuple(
            result
        )

    def plan(
        self,
        *,
        subject_id: str,
        baseline:
            Mapping[str, Any],
        target:
            Mapping[str, Any],
        dependencies:
            Iterable[str] = (),
        migration_steps:
            Iterable[
                Mapping[str, Any]
            ] = (),
        recovery_steps:
            Iterable[
                Mapping[str, Any]
            ] = (),
        supersedes:
            str | None = None,
        lineage: Any = None,
        provenance: Any = None,
    ) -> Transition:
        subject_id = (
            subject_id.strip()
        )

        if not subject_id:
            raise SpyralError(
                "subject_id is required"
            )

        compatibility = (
            self.compatibility(
                baseline,
                target,
            )
        )

        migrations = (
            self._normalize_steps(
                migration_steps
            )
        )

        recovery = (
            self._normalize_steps(
                recovery_steps
            )
        )

        if (
            migrations
            and self.instance[
                "policy"
            ][
                "require_recovery_path"
            ]
            and not recovery
        ):
            raise SpyralError(
                "migration plan requires "
                "a recovery path"
            )

        dependency_values = tuple(
            sorted(
                {
                    str(value).strip()
                    for value
                    in dependencies
                    if str(value)
                    .strip()
                }
            )
        )

        identity_material = {
            "subject_id":
                subject_id,
            "baseline":
                dict(baseline),
            "target":
                dict(target),
            "dependencies":
                dependency_values,
            "migration_steps": [
                dict(value)
                for value
                in migrations
            ],
            "recovery_steps": [
                dict(value)
                for value
                in recovery
            ],
            "supersedes":
                supersedes,
            "lineage":
                lineage,
            "provenance":
                provenance,
        }

        transition_id = (
            "transition:"
            + digest(
                identity_material
            )[:24]
        )

        return Transition(
            transition_id=(
                transition_id
            ),
            subject_id=subject_id,
            baseline=dict(
                baseline
            ),
            target=dict(
                target
            ),
            dependencies=(
                dependency_values
            ),
            compatibility=(
                compatibility
            ),
            migration_steps=(
                migrations
            ),
            recovery_steps=(
                recovery
            ),
            supersedes=(
                supersedes
            ),
            lineage=lineage,
            provenance=provenance,
        )

    def migration_manifest(
        self,
        transition: Transition,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        projection = (
            transition.projection()
        )

        payload = {
            "schema": (
                "savant://runtime/"
                "spyral/migration-manifest/"
                "1.0.0"
            ),
            "instance_id": (
                self.instance[
                    "instance_id"
                ]
            ),
            "transition_id": (
                transition.transition_id
            ),
            "subject_id": (
                transition.subject_id
            ),
            "compatibility": (
                transition
                .compatibility
                .projection()
            ),
            "dependencies": list(
                transition.dependencies
            ),
            "steps": [
                dict(value)
                for value
                in transition
                .migration_steps
            ],
            "recovery": [
                dict(value)
                for value
                in transition
                .recovery_steps
            ],
            "source_digest": digest(
                transition.baseline
            ),
            "target_digest": digest(
                transition.target
            ),
            "transition_digest": (
                projection[
                    "digest"
                ]
            ),
            "manifest_is_projection":
                True,
            "mutation_authorized":
                False,
            "execution_authorized":
                False,
        }

        payload["digest"] = digest(
            payload
        )

        return payload

    def recovery_plan(
        self,
        transition: Transition,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        complete = (
            not transition
            .migration_steps
            or bool(
                transition
                .recovery_steps
            )
        )

        payload = {
            "schema": (
                "savant://runtime/"
                "spyral/recovery/1.0.0"
            ),
            "transition_id": (
                transition.transition_id
            ),
            "steps": [
                dict(value)
                for value
                in transition
                .recovery_steps
            ],
            "complete": complete,
            "authoritative": False,
            "execution_authorized":
                False,
        }

        payload["digest"] = digest(
            payload
        )

        return payload

    def replay_fingerprint(
        self,
        transition: Transition,
    ) -> str:
        return digest(
            {
                "transition":
                    transition
                    .projection(),
                "instance":
                    self.instance[
                        "instance_id"
                    ],
                "schema":
                    self.schema,
            }
        )

    def compare_replay(
        self,
        left: Transition,
        right: Transition,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        left_digest = (
            self.replay_fingerprint(
                left
            )
        )

        right_digest = (
            self.replay_fingerprint(
                right
            )
        )

        payload = {
            "schema": (
                "savant://runtime/"
                "spyral/replay/1.0.0"
            ),
            "left":
                left_digest,
            "right":
                right_digest,
            "diverged": (
                left_digest
                != right_digest
            ),
            "blocking": (
                left_digest
                != right_digest
            ),
            "authoritative": False,
        }

        payload["digest"] = digest(
            payload
        )

        return payload

    def impact(
        self,
        transition: Transition,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        before = dict(
            transition.baseline
        )

        after = dict(
            transition.target
        )

        keys = sorted(
            set(before)
            | set(after)
        )

        changes = []

        for key in keys:
            left = before.get(
                key
            )

            right = after.get(
                key
            )

            if left == right:
                continue

            changes.append(
                {
                    "field": key,
                    "before": left,
                    "after": right,
                }
            )

        payload = {
            "schema": (
                "savant://runtime/"
                "spyral/impact/1.0.0"
            ),
            "transition_id":
                transition.transition_id,
            "change_count":
                len(changes),
            "changes":
                changes,
            "dependencies":
                list(
                    transition
                    .dependencies
                ),
            "compatibility":
                transition
                .compatibility
                .projection(),
            "authoritative":
                False,
        }

        payload["digest"] = digest(
            payload
        )

        return payload

    def health(

        dimensions = {

                self.instance[

            "provenance_preservation": (

                ]

            "compatibility_integrity": (
                self.instance[

                    "require_compatibility_analysis"
                ]
            ),

            "recovery_integrity": (
                self.instance[
                    "policy"
                ][
                    "require_recovery_path"
                ]
            ),

            "replay_integrity":
                True,

            "mutation_boundary": (

                ]
                is False
            ),

            "coda_integration": (

                == "exile:coda"
            ),
        }

        payload = {
            "schema": (
                "savant://runtime/"
                "spyral/health/1.0.0"
            ),
            "dimensions": {
                name: {
                    "healthy":
                        bool(value)
                }
                for name, value
                in dimensions.items()
            },
            "healthy": all(
                dimensions.values()
            ),
        }

        payload["digest"] = digest(
            payload
        )

        return payload

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react"
import * as d3 from "d3"

export default function ForceGraph({
  graph
}){

  const ref = useRef()

  useEffect(()=>{

    if(
      !graph ||
      !ref.current
    ) return

    const svg =
      d3.select(ref.current)

    svg.selectAll("*")
      .remove()

    const width = 900
    const height = 700

    svg
      .attr(
        "viewBox",
        [0,0,width,height]
      )

    const nodes =
      [...(graph.nodes||[])]

    const links =
      [...(graph.edges||[])]

    const sim =
      d3.forceSimulation(nodes)
        .force(
          "link",
          d3.forceLink(links)
            .id(d=>d.id)
            .distance(80)
        )
        .force(
          "charge",
          d3.forceManyBody()
            .strength(-120)
        )
        .force(
          "center",
          d3.forceCenter(
            width/2,
            height/2
          )
        )

    const link =
      svg.append("g")
        .selectAll("line")
        .data(links)
        .enter()
        .append("line")

    const node =
      svg.append("g")
        .selectAll("circle")
        .data(nodes)
        .enter()
        .append("circle")
        .attr("r",3)

    sim.on("tick",()=>{

      link
        .attr("x1",d=>d.source.x)
        .attr("y1",d=>d.source.y)
        .attr("x2",d=>d.target.x)
        .attr("y2",d=>d.target.y)

      node
        .attr("cx",d=>d.x)
        .attr("cy",d=>d.y)

    })

  },[graph])

  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      style={{
        width:"100%",
        height:"100%",
      }}
    />
  )
}

import type { Capabilities, QualityTier } from "../types";

export function selectQualityTier(c: Capabilities): QualityTier {
  if (!c.webgl2) return "essential";
  if (c.reducedMotion) return "mobile";
  const constrained =
    (c.deviceMemory !== null && c.deviceMemory <= 4) ||
    c.hardwareConcurrency <= 4 ||
    c.maxTextureSize < 8192;
  if (constrained) return "mobile";
  if (
    (c.deviceMemory ?? 8) >= 8 &&
    c.hardwareConcurrency >= 8 &&
    c.maxTextureSize >= 16384 &&
    c.dpr <= 2.5
  )
    return "ultra";
  return "standard";
}

        operation="plan",

def timestamp() -> str:
    return datetime.now(
        timezone.utc
    ).strftime(
        "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ"
    )


def main() -> int:
    if not TARGET.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"missing target: {TARGET}"
        )

    source = TARGET.read_text(
        encoding="utf-8"
    )

    if NEW in source:
        py_compile.compile(
            str(TARGET),
            doraise=True,
        )

        print(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "operation": (
                        "fix_modular_pipeline_plan_return"
                    ),
                    "passed": True,
                    "mutation_performed": False,
                    "state": "already-correct",
                    "target": str(TARGET),
                    "plan_return_codes": [0, 1],
                },
                indent=2,
                sort_keys=True,
            )
        )

        return 0

    if OLD not in source:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Plan stage does not match the "
            "expected verified pre-change form."
        )

    if source.count(OLD) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Expected exactly one old plan-stage contract."
        )

    updated = source.replace(
        OLD,
        NEW,
        1,
    )

    backup_dir = (
        BACKUP_ROOT
        / timestamp()
    )

    backup_dir.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=False,
    )

    backup_path = (
        backup_dir
        / "run_modular_pipeline.py"
    )

    shutil.copy2(
        TARGET,
        backup_path,
    )

    try:
        TARGET.write_text(
            updated,
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        py_compile.compile(
            str(TARGET),
            doraise=True,
        )

        installed = TARGET.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )

        if installed.count(NEW) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "New plan-stage contract was not installed exactly once."
            )

        audit_index = installed.index(
            'key="audit"'
        )

        plan_index = installed.index(
            'key="plan"'
        )

        classification_index = installed.index(
            'key="classification"'
        )

        audit_block = installed[
            audit_index:plan_index
        ]

        plan_block = installed[
            plan_index:classification_index
        ]

        if (
            "acceptable_return_codes=(0, 1, 2)"
            not in audit_block
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Audit-stage return contract changed unexpectedly."
            )

        if (
            "acceptable_return_codes=(0, 1)"
            not in plan_block
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Plan-stage return contract was not installed."
            )

    except BaseException:
        shutil.copy2(
            backup_path,
            TARGET,
        )
        raise

    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "operation": (
                    "fix_modular_pipeline_plan_return"
                ),
                "passed": True,
                "mutation_performed": True,
                "target": str(TARGET),
                "backup": str(
                    backup_path
                ),
                "previous_plan_return_codes": [
                    0,
                    2,
                ],
                "current_plan_return_codes": [
                    0,
                    1,
                ],
                "audit_return_codes_preserved": [
                    0,
                    1,
                    2,
                ],
            },
            indent=2,
            sort_keys=True,
        )
    )

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(
        main()
    )

import json
import py_compile
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/root/savant-runtime")
DB = ROOT / "audit/fs_compiler/db/savant_fs_compiler.sqlite"

con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
cur = con.cursor()

cur.executescript("""
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS compile_audit (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    file_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    path TEXT NOT NULL,
    language TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    message TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_compile_audit_status
ON compile_audit(status);
""")

cur.execute("DELETE FROM compile_audit")

rows = cur.execute("""
    SELECT id, path, extension, basename
    FROM files
    WHERE ignored=0
      AND kind='file'
    ORDER BY path
""").fetchall()

for file_id, path_text, extension, basename in rows:
    path = Path(path_text)

    if extension == "py":
        try:
            py_compile.compile(str(path), doraise=True)
            status = "ok"
            message = ""
        except Exception as e:
            status = "fail"
            message = str(e)

        cur.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO compile_audit
            (file_id, path, language, status, message)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """,
            (file_id, str(path), "python", status, message)
        )

    elif extension == "sh":
        try:
            proc = subprocess.run(
                ["bash", "-n", str(path)],
                text=True,
                capture_output=True,
                timeout=20
            )
            status = "ok" if proc.returncode == 0 else "fail"
            message = (proc.stderr or proc.stdout or "").strip()
        except Exception as e:
            status = "fail"
            message = str(e)

        cur.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO compile_audit
            (file_id, path, language, status, message)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """,
            (file_id, str(path), "shell", status, message)
        )

    elif extension == "json":
        try:
            json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))
            status = "ok"
            message = ""
        except Exception as e:
            status = "fail"
            message = str(e)

        cur.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO compile_audit
            (file_id, path, language, status, message)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """,
            (file_id, str(path), "json", status, message)
        )

con.commit()

print("[OK] pass 17 compile audit complete")

for language, status, count in cur.execute("""
    SELECT language, status, count(*)
    FROM compile_audit
    GROUP BY language, status
    ORDER BY language, status
"""):

con.close()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import sys

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Mapping


carbon_root = Path(
    "/root/savant-runtime/"
    "ontology/obelisks/_template/"
    "segue/gates/_template/segue/"
    "innates/_template/segue/"
    "exiles/carbon"
)

runtime_root = (
    carbon_root
    / "runtime"
)

if str(runtime_root) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(
        0,
        str(runtime_root),
    )


from oriel_boundary import (  # noqa: E402
    selftest as boundary_selftest,
)

from oriel_canon import (  # noqa: E402
    selftest as canon_selftest,
)

from oriel_capabilities import (  # noqa: E402
    collect as collect_capabilities,
)

from oriel_observatory import (  # noqa: E402
    status as observatory_status,
)

from oriel_simulation import (  # noqa: E402
    selftest as simulation_selftest,
)


schema = "savant.carbon.oriel-integration-test.v1"
owner = "carbon"
component = "oriel-integration-test"
authority_effect = "none"


class oriel_integration_error(
    RuntimeError
):
    pass


def canonical_json(
    value: Any,
) -> str:
    return json.dumps(
        value,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        default=str,
    )


def digest(
    value: Any,
) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(
        canonical_json(
            value
        ).encode(
            "utf-8"
        )
    ).hexdigest()


def load_json(
    path: Path,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        value = json.loads(
            path.read_text(
                encoding="utf-8"
            )
        )

    except OSError as exc:
        raise oriel_integration_error(
            (
                "cannot read "
                + str(path)
                + ": "
                + str(exc)
            )
        ) from exc

    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise oriel_integration_error(
            (
                "invalid json in "
                + str(path)
                + ": "
                + str(exc)
            )
        ) from exc

    if not isinstance(
        value,
        dict,
    ):
        raise oriel_integration_error(
            (
                "expected json object: "
                + str(path)
            )
        )

    return value


def require_true(
    value: Mapping[str, Any],
    field: str,
    label: str,
) -> None:
    if value.get(
        field
    ) is not True:
        raise oriel_integration_error(
            (
                label
                + " did not prove "
                + field
            )
        )


def validate_declared_json(
    policy: Mapping[str, Any],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    rows = []

    for relative_path in policy.get(
        "required_json",
        [],
    ):
        relative = str(
            relative_path
        ).strip()

        if not relative:
            continue

        path = (
            carbon_root
            / relative
        )

        value = load_json(
            path
        )

        rows.append(
            {
                "path":
                    relative,

                "id":
                    value.get(
                        "id"
                    ),

                "valid":
                    True,
            }
        )

    return rows


def run() -> dict[str, Any]:
    policy = load_json(
        carbon_root
        / "validation/oriel.json"
    )

    if policy.get(
        "id"
    ) != "carbon.validation.oriel":
        raise oriel_integration_error(
            "unexpected validation policy"
        )

    json_checks = validate_declared_json(
        policy
    )

    simulation = simulation_selftest()

    if not isinstance(
        simulation,
        Mapping,
    ):
        raise oriel_integration_error(
            (
                "oriel simulation selftest "
                "did not return an object"
            )
        )

    require_true(
        simulation,
        "ok",
        "oriel simulation selftest",
    )

    boundary = boundary_selftest()

    if not isinstance(
        boundary,
        Mapping,
    ):
        raise oriel_integration_error(
            (
                "oriel boundary selftest "
                "did not return an object"
            )
        )

    require_true(
        boundary,
        "ok",
        "oriel boundary selftest",
    )

    canon = canon_selftest()

    if not isinstance(
        canon,
        Mapping,
    ):
        raise oriel_integration_error(
            (
                "oriel canon selftest "
                "did not return an object"
            )
        )

    require_true(
        canon,
        "ok",
        "oriel canon selftest",
    )

    observatory = observatory_status()

    if not isinstance(
        observatory,
        Mapping,
    ):
        raise oriel_integration_error(
            (
                "oriel observatory status "
                "did not return an object"
            )
        )

    if observatory.get(
        "ready"
    ) is not True:
        raise oriel_integration_error(
            (
                "oriel observatory "
                "is not ready"
            )
        )

    observed_state = str(
        observatory.get(
            "observed_state",
            "",
        )
    ).strip().lower()

    allowed_states = {
        str(value).strip().lower()
        for value
        in policy.get(
            "closure_check",
            {},
        ).get(
            "allowed_states",
            [],
        )
    }

    if (
        observed_state
        not in allowed_states
    ):
        raise oriel_integration_error(
            (
                "oriel observatory state "
                "is not closure-compatible: "
                + observed_state
            )
        )

    capabilities = collect_capabilities()

    if not isinstance(
        capabilities,
        Mapping,
    ):
        raise oriel_integration_error(
            (
                "oriel capability collection "
                "did not return an object"
            )
        )

    unavailable = list(
        capabilities.get(
            "unavailable_modules",
            [],
        )
    )

    unmanifested = list(
        capabilities.get(
            "unmanifested_modules",
            [],
        )
    )

    provider_errors = list(
        capabilities.get(
            "provider_errors",
            [],
        )
    )

    if unavailable:
        raise oriel_integration_error(
            (
                "unavailable oriel providers: "
                + ", ".join(
                    str(value)
                    for value
                    in unavailable
                )
            )
        )

    if unmanifested:
        raise oriel_integration_error(
            (
                "unmanifested oriel providers: "
                + ", ".join(
                    str(value)
                    for value
                    in unmanifested
                )
            )
        )

    if provider_errors:
        raise oriel_integration_error(
            (
                "oriel provider errors: "
                + canonical_json(
                    provider_errors
                )
            )
        )

    invariant_packets = (
        simulation,
        boundary,
        canon,
        observatory,
        capabilities,
    )

    for packet in invariant_packets:
        if packet.get(
            "authority_transfer",
            False,
        ) is not False:
            raise oriel_integration_error(
                "authority transfer detected"
            )

    result = {
        "schema":
            schema,

        "kind":
            "focused-integration-test",

        "owner":
            owner,

        "component":
            component,

        "authority_effect":
            authority_effect,

        "ok":
            True,

        "json_documents_valid":
            True,

        "json_document_count":
            len(
                json_checks
            ),

        "reality_bound_simulation_operational":
            True,

        "authority_boundary_valid":
            True,

        "canon_boundary_valid":
            True,

        "observatory_ready":
            True,

        "observed_state":
            observed_state,

        "capability_surface_resolved":
            True,

        "unavailable_module_count":
            0,

        "unmanifested_module_count":
            0,

        "provider_error_count":
            0,

        "historical_oriel_not_restored":
            (
                boundary.get(
                    (
                        "historical_oriel_"
                        "not_reactivated"
                    )
                )
                is True
            ),

        "carbon_remains_general_simulation_owner":
            True,

        "quantum_remains_carbon_owned":
            (
                boundary.get(
                    "quantum_remains_carbon_owned"
                )
                is True
            ),

        "causal_simulation_remains_carbon_owned":
            (
                boundary.get(
                    (
                        "causal_simulation_"
                        "remains_carbon_owned"
                    )
                )
                is True
            ),

        "historical_reality_remains_external":
            (
                boundary.get(
                    (
                        "historical_reality_"
                        "remains_external"
                    )
                )
                is True
            ),

        "source_state_mutated":
            False,

        "canon_effect":
            "none",

        "evidence_admission":
            False,

        "authority_transfer":
            False,

        "json_checks":
            json_checks,
    }

    required_final = (
        "historical_oriel_not_restored",
        "quantum_remains_carbon_owned",
        "causal_simulation_remains_carbon_owned",
        "historical_reality_remains_external",
    )

    failed_final = [
        field
        for field
        in required_final
        if result.get(
            field
        )
        is not True
    ]

    if failed_final:
        raise oriel_integration_error(
            (
                "closure invariants failed: "
                + ", ".join(
                    failed_final
                )
            )
        )

    result[
        "digest"
    ] = digest(
        {
            key:
                value
            for key, value
            in result.items()
            if key != "digest"
        }
    )

    return result


def main() -> int:
    try:
        output = run()

    except Exception as exc:
        print(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "schema":
                        schema,

                    "kind":
                        "focused-integration-test",

                    "owner":
                        owner,

                    "component":
                        component,

                    "authority_effect":
                        authority_effect,

                    "ok":
                        False,

                    "error":
                        str(exc),

                    "authority_transfer":
                        False,
                },
                indent=2,
                sort_keys=True,
            )
        )

        return 1

    print(
        json.dumps(
            output,
            indent=2,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            sort_keys=True,
        )
    )

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(
        main()
    )
